purpose: Real device-independent same-identity mission: audit a live Project Brain dependency binding against authoritative current metadata, persist and revalidate the result, then force missing-capability acquisition through a useful binary recovery artifact.
goal: Read canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json and identify the bound PyPI project and version for capability auto.pypi.msgpack. Fetch authoritative current metadata from https://pypi.org/pypi/msgpack/json, determine the current latest stable msgpack version, compare it with the bound version, and write canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/SUPERWORKER_UNIFIED_MSGPACK_FRESHNESS_001.json containing capability_id, project, bound_version, latest_version, is_current, and source_url. Independently re-fetch or revalidate the authoritative source and verify that record is correct. Then encode canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/SUPERWORKER_UNIFIED_MSGPACK_FRESHNESS_001.json as UBJSON to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/SUPERWORKER_UNIFIED_MSGPACK_FRESHNESS_001.ubj using a zero-cost library. Finally independently decode the UBJSON artifact using a different implementation than the producer and verify that the decoded object is exactly identical to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/SUPERWORKER_UNIFIED_MSGPACK_FRESHNESS_001.json in values, field names, nested structure, and record count, saving the verification result to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/SUPERWORKER_UNIFIED_MSGPACK_FRESHNESS_001_VERIFIED.json.
